title: Build an LRU cache in Python — 3 turns
description: Three scripted turns build an LRU cache: turn 1 adds put/get with a no-op eviction path, turn 2 implements LRU eviction when capacity is exceeded, turn 3 adds clear() and runs the full suite.

files.tests/test_lru_cache.py:
import pytest
from lru_cache import LRUCache


def test_basic_put_get():
    c = LRUCache(2)
    c.put(1, 10)
    assert c.get(1) == 10


def test_missing_key_returns_minus_one():
    c = LRUCache(2)
    assert c.get(99) == -1


def test_update_existing_key():
    c = LRUCache(2)
    c.put(1, 10)
    c.put(1, 20)
    assert c.get(1) == 20


def test_eviction_lru():
    c = LRUCache(2)
    c.put(1, 1)
    c.put(2, 2)
    c.get(1)       # 1 is now most recently used
    c.put(3, 3)    # should evict 2 (LRU), not 1
    assert c.get(2) == -1
    assert c.get(1) == 1
    assert c.get(3) == 3


def test_eviction_order_put():
    c = LRUCache(3)
    c.put("a", 1)
    c.put("b", 2)
    c.put("c", 3)
    c.put("d", 4)  # should evict "a"
    assert c.get("a") == -1
    assert c.get("b") == 2


def test_clear():
    c = LRUCache(3)
    c.put(1, 1)
    c.put(2, 2)
    c.clear()
    assert c.get(1) == -1
    assert c.get(2) == -1


def test_capacity_one():
    c = LRUCache(1)
    c.put(1, 100)
    c.put(2, 200)
    assert c.get(1) == -1
    assert c.get(2) == 200


def test_invalid_capacity():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        LRUCache(0)

task_spec.prompt: Implement `get(key)` and `put(key, value)` in `lru_cache.py`. For now, just make get/put work correctly (no eviction needed yet — if the cache is over capacity just leave it). Use `self._store` (an OrderedDict). Run `uv run pytest tests/ -q` when you think it's working.
followup_prompts: Good. Now implement LRU eviction in `put()`: when the cache exceeds capacity, remove the least-recently-used entry. Also make sure `get()` moves the accessed key to the 'most recently used' position. Run `uv run pytest tests/ -q` and fix any failures.
Final step: implement `clear()` so it removes all entries. Then run `uv run pytest tests/ -q` one more time — all 8 tests must be green.
success_criteria: get() promotes accessed key to MRU position
